hypothesis: Reuse a standardized off-lease thin-client compute/enclosure subsystem as a tested donor module, then add a new Hardware-Splicer-designed protection/I-O sidecar and variant-specific acceptance workflow for a low-cost lab/bench automation node.
positioning_boundary: Bench/lab automation only. This probe does not claim industrial temperature range, safety certification, hazardous-location suitability, long-term industrial supply, or feature equivalence to certified industrial controllers.

donor_population.identity_requirement: Exact approved model/revision only; unit identity and board/revision evidence must be captured before reuse.

observations.notes: Used unit only; listing reported 205 sold. Historical sold quantity is demand/supply context, not current available inventory.
